    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from typing import Dict, Any

async def resolve_cached_user_settings(
    profile_id: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    profile_service: ProfileService = Depends(get_profile_service)
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if current_user.id != profile_id and not current_user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: user lacks permission to access other profile settings")

    settings = await profile_service.get_private_settings(profile_id)
    if not settings:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Profile settings not found")
    return settings

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/profiles")

@router.get("/{profile_id}/settings")
async def get_profile_settings(
    settings: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(resolve_cached_user_settings, use_cache=False)
):
    return settings
